title: Hero of Love
text: After that, I fought the waves extremely slowly. It looked like it was going to turn into such a long battle that, if I wasn’t careful, I might end up merging with the other world. It’s frustrating not being able to wipe them out all at once.

……The idea of making it look like an accident to take out the Crimson Swine crosses my mind, but if the Crimson Swine were to suffer serious injuries, it might cause trouble for my Father. I’ll just have to hold off until my Father arrives.
“Motoyasu! Don’t be afraid—just attack already!”
“I know that!”
Ren is giving me some kind of advice here. Ah… that’s right. I recorded Ren fighting using the video crystal I brought from the castle’s warehouse.
“Everyone! Let’s finish them off in one go right here! We’re going to bring peace to the world with our own strength!”

And… Itsuki was launching some half-assed attacks alongside a bunch of unreliable folks. Ah… Looking back now, those three hours were incredibly frustrating. Eventually, after three hours, we defeated the boss, and just as we were starting to breathe a sigh of relief… a pig wielding a fan showed up. We fought that pig for a while, and just as we’d cornered it, it hit us with a powerful move, and we all lost consciousness.
“Bubub! Bubub! Oink!”
Anyway, after exchanging blows with the fan-wielding pig a few times, for some reason, it got angry at me.
“Motoyasu, aren’t you fighting seriously?”
“Well, I am fighting seriously.”
“Am I?”
“I sense something fishy.”
Ugh… this fan-wielding pig… to see right through my holding back—that’s impressive.
“I’m not holding back at all! Haaaaaa!”
With that, I relaxed my strength as much as possible and attacked the Fan Pig with a stance full of openings.

The Fan Pig… its movements are sharp. If I were going all out, I could easily turn the tables on it, but the truth is, it’s hard to hold back. I’m barely managing to hold back with the weakest spear… Alright, time to unleash my special move. Glancing back, I saw my Father approaching.
“Alright! Here I go! Meteor Sword!”
“I’ll finish this in one go! Meteor Bow!”
“Taaaaa Meteor Thrust—”
Oops, out of habit, I almost unleashed a power-up skill. Just then, Fan Pig fired a shockwave skill that scattered petals all around, and we were blown away.
“Guh!”
We rolled right to Father’s feet. Round and round and round and round———— we rolled way farther than necessary all the way to my Father’s feet, and I’m pretty sure…
“I’ll leave the rest to you.”
At that, Father’s face turned incredibly displeased. Hmm? It felt like the father-in-law from the first world in my memory was saying, “Nope. You idiot.” Did I get that wrong?
“The Meteor Sword should’ve hit…”
“The Meteor Bow should’ve hit…”
Ah! That’s right!
“…The Meteor Thrust should’ve connected…”
I chimed in too. Course correction complete!
“Motoyasu looks like he’s goofing off… Is that a trend? Or something?”

I mustn’t answer that. I have to pretend to be unconscious… Then Father started interacting with the pig holding the fan. It looks like he stepped on the Crimson Swine’s face in the middle of it. Hahaha! What a sight!
“Can I copy you too, Filo-tan?”
Filo-tan is lifting her foot to try to crush me!? Eeeeeek! I want to run away from here right now!
“Don’t do it. You’ll really die this time.”
“O-okay.”
Phew, that’s a relief. Ugh… so all this happened while I was unconscious.
“…The Spear Hero… is he really unconscious?”
Big Sister! Your intuition is as sharp as Father’s! Is it because you’re a Tanuki that you’re so good at seeing through things?
“Is that so?”
Oh no! Filo-tan is leaning her face close to me while I’m pretending to be asleep. Eeeeeek!? Her voice is terrifying!
“U… uu…”
I was trying my best not to make a sound, but a moan slipped out.
“Just leave the guy who’s unconscious alone. Let’s focus on the battle right now!”
“Okay!”
“You’re right. There’s no point in playing dead here.”

Thanks to Father’s warning, my sister and Filo-tan seem to have turned their attention to the fan-wielding pig. Then, the battle between Father and the fan-wielding pig began. Partway through, Father used his Shield of Wrath, and Big Sister started helping him aim it at the fan-wielding pig.

I figured it’d be fine to lend a hand at this point! I shrunk my spear to the size of a toothpick, and just as Big Sister was about to launch a surprise attack on the fan-wielding pig—I fired an Air Strike Javelin, aiming right at its leg with a sharp “Pit!”
“Buh!?”

Big Sister and the fan-wielding pig let out strange cries, but I’d successfully created an opening. Father landed an Iron Maiden, and the fan-wielding pig fled in defeat. HAHAHA! What a victory! It was dragging its leg along rather pitifully.

The Iron Maiden alone isn’t very effective, but if I’d provided some fire-elemental support, would I have been able to finish off the fan-wielding pig? Of course, if I’d cast Liberation, I would’ve been found out, so I held back. I really wanted to cast Magic while hiding behind Father’s flames.

Big Sister has returned and is crouching over me as I lie unconscious on the ground, staring intently. It looks like other villagers are gathering around us as well. Pretend to be unconscious, pretend to be unconscious… No, since the battle is over, it’s fine to get up now.
“U… uu… Where am I… That’s right. I’m…”
Big Sister is staring at me without saying a word.
“Weren’t you… pretending to be asleep?”
I flinched. If I stutter here, my plan will be exposed!
“What are you… talking about? More importantly, what about that enemy from earlier!?”
I almost said “I am,” but I caught myself. I’ll change the subject.
“Naofumi-sama already drove it away.”
“Aaaah—”
“Don’t eat it.”
Filo-tan was about to eat the Soul Eater right from the head when my Father scolded her. Anyway, I’ll get up and go over to where my Father and the others are.
“Ah, so Motoyasu is awake already. It’d be so much easier if you just stayed asleep… But more importantly, is this okay?”

My father is guiding my gaze toward the Crimson Swine. I thought about delivering the finishing blow, but honestly, the me from back then would’ve gone over there out of concern for the Crimson Swine. Still, it’s probably better to help my father, who seems to be in a bind.
“You’re going to butcher it, right? We’ll split the spoils.”
“…So you’d rather have ingredients than a woman?”
My father is looking at me with a puzzled expression. Uh… that’s a bit hard to counter. I’ve started to get the feeling that my standing in his eyes has taken a hit.
“Aka… Myne is being looked after by the villagers.”
I almost said, “That’s right.” Honestly, I couldn’t care less about the Crimson Swine.
“Fine. So, how are you going to cut this up?”
I switched my spear to one with an elemental attribute and quickly dispatched the Soul Eater.
“Cut it into four equal parts.”
“…I thought you were going to say you wouldn’t give me any?”
My father said this with a look of surprise.
“You took down that w… woman earlier, didn’t you? So, I suppose I’ll let you have a little.”
“Ha!”
My father muttered a contemptuous remark at me as he took about a quarter of the Soul Eater’s materials.
After that, I… watched as Crimson Swine, Ren, Itsuki, and the others were transported to a nearby clinic, then quietly slipped away from the group to meet up with Fleon-chan.
“Kueh.”
When I beckoned to her, Fleon-chan fluttered down.
“Kueh!”

Her little pose is just part of her charm. Well then… we’ve managed to weather the storm. Next up is the commotion over my Finacée’s kidnapping… but we still have a little time left. We must act so as not to waste this time. First, we need to meet up with the Immortal Filolial. It’s time to unveil Fleon-chan in her angelic form.
“Fleon-chan, I’d like you to take on your angelic form after we visit Filolial-sama.”
“Kue!”
Fleon-chan nodded, as if she understood. But… she seems to be looking toward the village. My Father and the others, along with Ren and Itsuki, will be sleeping there tonight.
“I understand you’re worried, but you’ll have to be patient for now.”
“Kwe…”
So, we returned to the castle town a little early. And that’s how we met up with Filolial-sama. In a secluded stable, the Hermit and I spoke with Fleon-chan.
“Spear Hero, how did things go?”
“No problems to speak of. Now then… Fleon-chan, since the Hermit is here as well, I’d like you to take on the form of an angel.”
“Kwaa”
And so, Fleon-chan spread her wings, struck some sort of pose… and transformed. And the form Fleon-chan took was… oh, what a sight!

She looked very much like Filo-tan… no, she looked very much like the Fleon-chan I remember—an angel with red eyes and golden hair. She looks very much like the Fallen Angel Fleon-chan. The difference is probably the wings. When Fleon-chan from the game fell from grace, she had demon wings. But this is the Fallen Angel Fleon-chan with angel wings!
“Hero of Love! Fleon is here!”
And with that, Fleon-chan strikes a victory pose.
“W-what…?”
Even the hermit’s mouth is agape in surprise.
“Thank you so much for showing me your angelic form!”
“It’s no big deal. Still, Toyasu-san, what exactly do you want from this Fleon? Depending on the situation, I might lend you a hand!”
This energy… it’s just like the fun-loving Fallen Angel Fleon-chan—it feels great! Things are really heating up!
“First, we’ll have to make some clothes for Fleon-chan. She can’t go around naked, you know.”
“Got it. So… we’ll have to make a hero outfit!”
“What kind of outfit would you like?”
“I want a hero’s outfit!”
Hmm… I’m not quite sure. What exactly is a hero’s outfit?
“Would the outfit Filo-tan was wearing work?”
I think that outfit suits you best of all.
“That one? Sure, that’s fine. First, we have to put on some clothes! Let’s make the second outfit the hero’s.”
“It’s a relief you’re so understanding! Well then…”

I’ll ask Fleon-chan to show everyone the equipment I prepared in advance—the one that turns Magical Power into thread—and have her run it. Later, we’ll have it made into fabric and create the outfit. Fleon-chan has graciously agreed to my request and is operating the equipment for us.
“Even so, Toyasu-san, Immortal-san…”
“Hmm…”
It seems the Immortal is at a loss for words. I’ll handle this for now.
“What is it?”
“Fleon was watching the ‘Battle of the Waves’ from the sky. That’s when she spotted someone who really caught her attention.”
Someone who caught her attention, you say? Who on earth could that be?
“I see… Who might that be?”
“The one fighting with a bow. I felt a strong sense of sympathy for what that person said about justice.”
“…Is it Itsuki?”
Judging by the description, it’s undoubtedly Itsuki.
“Itsuki… Fleon is very intrigued by Itsuki.”
“Itsuki, you say… How exactly does Itsuki intrigue you, Fleon-chan?”
“First of all, Fleon could relate to the fact that he possesses a sense of justice. However… I feel as though that sense of justice is tainted by a great many impurities.”

Thinking back on Itsuki’s past… that’s certainly true. Itsuki always causes trouble when it comes to justice. The only time he’s been well-behaved was in the loop where I told him the truth from the start.
“Therefore, Fleon would like to talk with Itsuki-san about what justice truly is. Please grant me permission to speak with him.”

I see… So Fleon-chan wants to talk with Itsuki about the concept of justice as she understands it. I’ve already strengthened Fleon as much as I could in the short time available. At the very least, she should be able to fight back against attacks from the Three Heroes Church or the Crimson Swine. Since the Crimson Swine can’t control the Monster Mark, it probably won’t be able to launch those strange attacks against Fleon, who’s become like Filo-tan. We’re out of danger now.
“Understood. Well then, once your clothes are finished, you may go talk things over with Itsuki.”
“Thank you so much, Motoyasu-san!”
And so, I heard that Fleon-chan wants to talk with Itsuki.
“Also, make sure to take good care of the hermit who cherished the egg Fleon-chan was inside.”
“Of course. “Thank you, Hermit, for protecting Fleon!”
“Ah, ah… It makes me very happy to hear that directly from a Filolial…”
The hermit seems quite satisfied.
“Now then, Fleon-chan, I’d like you to stay with the hermit tonight.”
“Yes. What are you going to do now, Motoyasu-san?”

Hmm… So Fleon-chan wants to talk under the Itsuki, does she? The fact that Fleon-chan is interested in the Itsuki… well, that works out quite well for me, too. Considering what’s to come, there will be an opportunity for Ren and the Itsuki—who’ve grown suspicious of the Three Heroes Church’s outrageous actions—to be lured into a trap.

At that time, since Fleon-chan will be with Itsuki, there’s no risk to him, but Ren might make a mistake… and Kage might fail to save him. Admittedly, things are deviating slightly from the plan. To be honest, when it comes to carrying out the plan, it doesn’t really matter what happens to Ren or Itsuki—but I’ve been asked by my Father, Shu, who went to Siltvelt with me.

At first, I had planned to send Filolial-sama to Ren, but when it came to Itsuki… well, that’s how it turned out. Plus, since Fleon-chan is being sent to Itsuki… I think it would be wise to boost Ren’s combat strength as well, considering what lies ahead.
I have a very good idea of who Filolial-sama—who gets along very well with Ren—might have in mind. It’s Kuro-chan, aka Black Thunder. Let’s go recruit Black Thunder as originally planned.
“Before we take our next step, I’ll make a quick report to the castle, then bring back a little someone for Filolial-sama.”
“Understood. Leave it to me.”
Ah, that voice reminds me of Fleon-chan from the game. You’re wonderful, Fleon-chan! It’s as if my very wishes have come to life right off the screen.

So, with Fleon-chan’s Magical Power transformed into thread, I headed straight to a shop I frequent in Siltvelt, paid a hefty sum, and had it woven into cloth. Aside from the time difference, it’s a huge help that Siltvelt is tolerant of different schedules, since there are nocturnal Demi-Humans there as well.
